create_schema_from_tensorizers: create a data schema from a dictionary of tensorizers with optional extra schema types
create_tensorizers_from_model_inputs: create tensorizer components from a model input configuration dictionary
train_new_task_model: train a NewTask model using PyTextConfig with optional distributed training rank and world size
predict_with_new_task: generate predictions and scores from example rows using a trained NewTask model
export_torchscript_model: export a trained model to TorchScript with optional quantization and accelerator lowering options
